stories.title: High Commendation in the John Locke Global Essay Prize
stories.headline: High Commendation
stories.subline: John Locke Institute Global Essay Prize 2026 · Junior Psychology
stories.summary: Nailah Haque of Class VIII has earned a High Commendation in the Junior Psychology category of the John Locke Institute Global Essay Competition 2026.
facts: John Locke Institute Global Essay Prize 2026
3 October 2026, London Hilton on Park Lane, Mayfair, London
body: Nailah Haque of Class VIII has earned a High Commendation in the Junior Psychology category of the John Locke Institute Global Essay Competition 2026, placing among the top 2–3% of over 100,227 submissions worldwide.
With a passion for writing and literature, Nailah explored the question: “Is mental illness over-diagnosed now, or just better recognized?”

In recognition of her achievement, Nailah was invited to attend the Awards Ceremony and Gala Dinner at the London Hilton on Park Lane, Mayfair, London. She was also awarded a £1,000 scholarship for a John Locke Summer School programme abroad.
The school extends its heartiest congratulations to Nailah on this outstanding accomplishment.
